subject: Borealis pilot launch: combined credits + discount — exec approval request
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@borealis.tech>
To: k arthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-13T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline / credits question

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo today — the team liked the latency & routing controls. We have internal momentum to run a scaled pilot across two product lines, but procurement is pushing for two things before we sign: a) a 60-day extension beyond the standard 30-day pilot to cover peak usage, and b) an upfront credit to offset integration and data prep costs.

Roughly what we had in mind: 90-day pilot total and $40k in platform credits. We also asked if there is any launch discount if we convert to a committed plan after pilot. Can you share what you can do on credits + an introductory/launch discount?

I can loop in Alex (procurement) if it helps. We’re targetting a decision by June 20.

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Product, Borealis Systems

From: k arthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Maya Singh <maya@borealis.tech>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-13T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline / credits question

Maya — really glad the demo landed. Appreciate the clarity on timeline.

High level we can support a 90-day pilot and we have flexibility on a combined credit + launch discount package, but I need to get exec sign-off for the numbers you quoted.

Proposed ask I’ll send up internally: 30% launch discount on first 12 months if you convert to a committed plan within 60 days of pilot close + $35k platform credit applied during pilot. I’m asking for a small carve that preserves our unit economics but gets you the runway to validate.

I’ll loop in Finance/RevOps and Marissa for executive approval this morning and will come back with a firm answer by EOD tomorrow (June 14). If that works, please CC Alex so procurement is in the thread.

Thanks — Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: k arthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-14T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request — Borealis pilot: 30% + $35k credits (DEAL-3841)
Attachments: Borealis_PILOT_SOW.pdf (stub); proposed_pricing_matrix.xlsx (stub); redwood_term_sheet_v2.pdf (stub)

Folks — quick ask for executive approval on a combined concession for Borealis Systems (DEAL-3841).

Why: Borealis is evaluating Redwood for two product lines (high throughput, multi-tenant routing). TAM > $1.2M ARR if pilot converts. They committed to a June 20 decision and will run a 90-day pilot if we provide launch economics. Risk is relatively low, but procurement will push back without credits and a short conversion window.

Requested package (what I will put on the wire):
- Pilot: 90 days (start on contract signature)
- Credits: $35,000 platform credit applied to pilot usage (one-time)
- Launch discount: 30% off list on first 12 months if Borealis signs a 12-month committed plan within 60 days after pilot close
- Standard terms otherwise (SLA 99.9, data controls in attached term sheet)

Business impact: converts faster, keeps total discount within our modeled ACV loss if converted (>60% chance according to forecast). This is a strategic target account for our retail/edge use case.

Please advise: approve as-is, approve with reduced credits/discount, or deny. I’ve attached the SOW & proposed pricing matrix for numbers.

Thanks — Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: k arthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-14T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — Borealis pilot: 30% + $35k credits (DEAL-3841)

Karthik — thanks for the summary and attachments. Thoughtful ask. Quick decision: approve, but with constraints.

Approved concession (final):
- Pilot: 90 days
- Credits: $30,000 platform credit (reduce by $5k)
- Launch discount: 20% off list on first 12 months if they convert to a 12-month committed plan within 45 days after pilot close

Conditions:
- Require the attached term sheet to be signed (redwood_term_sheet_v2.pdf) and include a clause to prevent stacking with other marketplace incentives.
- Legal to accept a 6-month early-conversion notice (we prefer 60 days but accept 45 for this strategic account).
- No additional credits beyond pilot without renewal approval from Sales Leader (Marissa).

Rationale: preserves runway to convert while limiting downside. If Karthik can get exec-level verbal from Borealis by Jun 20, we can fast-track signatures.

Approved by: Marissa Cole | Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts

From: k arthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Maya Singh <maya@borealis.tech>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@borealis.tech>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-15T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Approved pilot terms & next steps (Borealis)
Attachments: Borealis_PILOT_SOW.pdf (stub); redwood_term_sheet_v2.pdf (stub)

Maya — thanks for the quick response last week. Per internal review, we have approval to run the 90-day pilot under the following terms (final):

- Pilot duration: 90 days from signature
- Platform credits: $30,000 applied during pilot
- Launch discount: 20% off list for the first 12 months if Borealis signs a 12-month committed plan within 45 days after pilot close
- Standard Redwood terms in attached term sheet (privacy, SLA 99.9).

Next steps:
1) I’ve attached the SOW and term sheet for review.
2) If this looks good, I’ll generate the DocuSign with the pilot SOW and term sheet and send to Alex for signature.
3) We can kickoff onboarding within 3 business days after signature.

If you want the previous pricing matrix I circulated, I can attach it — otherwise this is the approved package. We’ll honor these terms if we receive executed signature by June 22 to meet your timeline.

Thanks — Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Maya Singh <maya@borealis.tech>
To: k arthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@borealis.tech>
Date: 2028-06-15T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approved pilot terms & next steps (Borealis)

Karthik — this looks good and thanks for moving quickly. Alex is looped for procurement — Alex, can you confirm if you have everything you need to sign? We prefer DocuSign but can run a PO after signature if necessary. Target: execute by June 21.

One quick ask from product: can we get a point of contact in your onboarding team to review data mappings before kickoff?

Thanks — Maya
